title: Claydy Wedding Environment Variables
description: VITE_* variables are exposed to the browser. Server secrets (DATABASE_URL, ADMIN_PASSWORD) must never use the VITE_ prefix.

DATABASE_URL.description: Neon PostgreSQL connection string. Server-only — never expose to the browser.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Optional override for the admin publish password. Defaults to couple2026 in the database.

VITE_API_URL.description: Optional API base URL for cross-origin setups. Leave empty when API is same-origin.

VITE_SITE_URL.description: Public site URL without trailing slash. Required for WhatsApp/iMessage link preview images.

VITE_COUPLE_NAMES.description: Fallback couple names for share previews before the API loads.

VITE_WEDDING_DATE.description: Fallback wedding date for share previews before the API loads.
